Monsters.name: Aboleth
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Amphibious.</Bold></Italic> The aboleth can breathe air and water. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Mucous Cloud.</Bold></Italic> While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Probing Telepathy.</Bold></Italic> If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tentacle.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Enslave (3/Day).</Bold></Italic> The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. </Paragraph><Paragraph>Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Legendary Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The aboleth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The aboleth regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Detect.</Bold></Italic> The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail Swipe.</Bold></Italic> The aboleth makes one tail attack. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Psychic Drain</Bold></Italic> (Costs 2 Actions). One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Amphibious.</Bold></Italic> The dragon can breathe air and water. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Legendary Resistance (3/Day).</Bold></Italic> If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Frightful Presence.</Bold></Italic> Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Poison Breath (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 56 (16d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Legendary Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Detect.</Bold></Italic> The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail Attack.</Bold></Italic> The dragon makes a tail attack. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).</Bold></Italic> The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Damage Resistances: Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Air Form.</Bold></Italic> The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The elemental makes two slam attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6).</Bold></Italic> Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and is flung up 20 feet away from the elemental in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes an object, such as a wall or floor, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone. </Paragraph><Paragraph>If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't flung away or knocked prone.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Amphibious.</Bold></Italic> The dragon can breathe air and water.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Legendary Resistance (3/Day).</Bold></Italic> If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Claw.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 18 (2d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Frightful Presence.</Bold></Italic> Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Lightning Breath.</Bold></Italic> The dragon exhales lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Repulsion Breath.</Bold></Italic> The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 60 feet away from the dragon.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Change Shape.</Bold></Italic> The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon's choice).</Paragraph><Paragraph>In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Legendary Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph>The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Detect.</Bold></Italic> The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Tail Attack.</Bold></Italic> The dragon makes a tail attack.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).</Bold></Italic> The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Inscrutable.</Bold></Italic> The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Magic Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The sphinx is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following cleric spells prepared: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">1st level (4 slots): command, detect evil and good, detect magic </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, zone of truth </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, tongues </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">5th level (2 slots): flame strike, greater restoration </Paragraph><Paragraph>6th level (1 slot): heroes' feast</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The sphinx makes two claw attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Roar (3/Day).</Bold></Italic> The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>First Roar.</Bold></Italic> Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Second Roar.</Bold></Italic> Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is deafened and frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature is paralyzed and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Third Roar.</Bold></Italic> Each creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Legendary Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The sphinx can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The sphinx regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw Attack.</Bold></Italic> The sphinx makes one claw attack. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Teleport (Costs 2 Actions).</Bold></Italic> The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions).</Bold></Italic> The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>False Appearance.</Bold></Italic> While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archmage can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:</Paragraph><Paragraph>Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, shocking grasp</Paragraph><Paragraph>1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, mage armor, magic missile</Paragraph><Paragraph>2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, misty step</Paragraph><Paragraph>3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, lightning bolt</Paragraph><Paragraph>4th level (3 slots): banishment, fire shield, stoneskin</Paragraph><Paragraph>5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, scrying, wall of force</Paragraph><Paragraph>6th level (1 slot): globe of invulnerability</Paragraph><Paragraph>7th level (1 slot): teleport</Paragraph><Paragraph>8th level (1 slot): mind blank</Paragraph><Paragraph>9th level (1 slot): time stop</Paragraph><Paragraph>*The archmage casts mind blank, stoneskin and mage armor spells on itself before combat.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Assassinate.</Bold></Italic> During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Evasion.</Bold></Italic> If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sneak Attack.</Bold></Italic> Once per turn, the assassin deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The assassin makes two shortsword attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shortsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Light Crossbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Balor

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Death Throes.</Bold></Italic> When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the balor's weapons. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Fire Aura.</Bold></Italic> At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The balor's weapon attacks are magical.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Longsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the balor scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Whip.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Teleport.</Bold></Italic> The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Detect Life.</Bold></Italic> The banshee can magically sense the presence of creatures up to 5 miles away that aren’t undead or constructs. She knows the general direction they’re in but not their exact locations.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Incorporeal Movement.</Bold></Italic> The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Corrupting Touch.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Spell Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Horrifying Visage.</Bold></Italic> Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the banshee that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the banshee is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the banshee’s Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Wail (1/Day).</Bold></Italic> The banshee releases a mournful wail, provided that she isn’t in sunlight. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet of her that can hear her must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Alternatively, it can use Hurl Flame twice. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hurl Flame.</Bold></Italic> Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Basilisk
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Petrifying Gaze.</Bold></Italic> If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.</Paragraph><Paragraph>A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.</Paragraph><Paragraph>If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 feet of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The devil makes two attacks: one with its beard and one with its glaive. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Beard.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Glaive.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or lose 5 (1d10) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 5 (1d10). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Behir

Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Constrict.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Swallow.</Bold></Italic> The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time. </Paragraph><Paragraph>If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Acid Absorption.</Bold></Italic> Whenever the golem is subjected to acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the acid damage dealt. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Berserk.</Bold></Italic> Whenever the golem starts its turn with 60 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Immutable Form.</Bold></Italic> The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The golem's weapon attacks are magical.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the cloaker has advantage against the target, the cloaker attaches to the target's head, and the target is blinded and unable to breathe while the cloaker is attached. While attached, the cloaker can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Moan.</Bold></Italic> Each creature within 60 feet of the cloaker that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the cloaker's moan for the next 24 hours. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Phantasms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest).</Bold></Italic> The cloaker magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which cloaker is the real one. If the cloaker is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear.</Paragraph><Paragraph>Whenever any creature targets the cloaker with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight.</Paragraph><Paragraph>A duplicate has the cloaker's AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Djinni
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Elemental Demise.</Bold></Italic> If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The djinni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, thunderwave </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">3/day each: create food and water (can create wine instead of water) , tongues, wind walk </Paragraph><Paragraph>1/day each: conjure elemental (air elemental only), creation, gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The djinni makes three scimitar attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Scimitar.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning or thunder damage (djinni's choice). </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Create Whirlwind.</Bold></Italic> A 5-foot-radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder of swirling air magically forms on a point the djinni can see within 120 feet of it. The whirlwind lasts as long as the djinni maintains concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). Any creature but the djinni that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained by it. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 60 feet as an action, and creatures restrained by the whirlwind move with it. The whirlwind ends if the djinni loses sight of it.</Paragraph><Paragraph>A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the whirlwind, including itself, by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. If the check succeeds, the creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the whirlwind.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Doppelganger
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shapechanger.</Bold></Italic> The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Ambusher.</Bold></Italic> The doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Surprise Attack.</Bold></Italic> If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The doppelganger makes two melee attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Read Thoughts.</Bold></Italic> The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the doppelganger's concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Draft Horse
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hooves.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Dragon Turtle
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Fire
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Amphibious.</Bold></Italic> The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The dragon turtle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Dretch
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The dretch makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 3 (1d6) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (2d4) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Fetid Cloud (1/Day).</Bold></Italic> A 10­-foot radius of disgusting green gas extends out from the dretch. The gas spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. Any creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both, and can't take reactions.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Drider
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Fey Ancestry.</Bold></Italic> The drider has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drider to sleep. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The drider's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). The drider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">At will: dancing lights </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">1/day each: darkness, faerie fire </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Spider Climb.</Bold></Italic> The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Sunlight Sensitivity.</Bold></Italic> While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Web Walker.</Bold></Italic> The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The drider makes three attacks, either with its longsword or its longbow. It can replace one of those attacks with a bite attack. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Longsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Longbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Drow
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Fey Ancestry.</Bold></Italic> The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put the drow to sleep.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The drow’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:</Paragraph><Paragraph>At will: dancing lights</Paragraph><Paragraph>1/day each: darkness, faerie fire</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sunlight Sensitivity.</Bold></Italic> While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shortsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hand Crossbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Druid
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave </Paragraph><Paragraph>2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, barkskin</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Quarterstaff.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Dryad
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The dryad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The dryad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">At will: druidcraft </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">3/day each: entangle, goodberry </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">1/day each: barkskin, pass without trace, shillelagh </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Speak with Beasts and Plants.</Bold></Italic> The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Tree Stride.</Bold></Italic> Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Club.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit (+6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Fey Charm.</Bold></Italic> The dryad targets one humanoid or beast that she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see the dryad, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards the dryad as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the dryad's control, it takes the dryad's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">Each time the dryad or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the dryad dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the dryad's Fey Charm for the next 24 hours. </Paragraph><Paragraph>The dryad can have no more than one humanoid and up to three beasts charmed at a time.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Duergar
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Poison
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Duergar Resilience.</Bold></Italic> The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sunlight Sensitivity.</Bold></Italic> While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest).</Bold></Italic> For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>War Pick.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Javelin.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee or <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic></Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest).</Bold></Italic> The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Dust Mephit
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Death Burst.</Bold></Italic> When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic>(1/Day). The mephit can innately cast sleep, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Blinding Breath (Recharge 6).</Bold></Italic> The mephit exhales a 15- foot cone of blinding dust. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Eagle
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Keen Sight.</Bold></Italic> The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Talons.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.  </Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Earth Elemental
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.,  Passive Perception 10
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Earth Glide.</Bold></Italic> The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Siege Monster.</Bold></Italic> The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The elemental makes two slam attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Efreeti
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Elemental Demise.</Bold></Italic> If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the efreeti was wearing or carrying. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The efreeti's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">At will: detect magic </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">3/day: enlarge/reduce, tongues </Paragraph><Paragraph>1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift, wall of fire</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The efreeti makes two scimitar attacks or uses its Hurl Flame twice. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Scimitar.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hurl Flame.</Bold></Italic> Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 17 (5d6) fire damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Elephant
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Trampling Charge.</Bold></Italic> If the elephant moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Gore.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Stomp.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Elk
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Charge.</Bold></Italic> If the elk moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Ram.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hooves.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Erinyes
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Cold; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Hellish Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit (included in the attacks). </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The erinyes makes three attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Longsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) poison damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Longbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. The poison lasts until it is removed by the lesser restoration spell or similar magic.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Ettercap
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Spider Climb.</Bold></Italic> The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Web Sense.</Bold></Italic> While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Web Walker.</Bold></Italic> The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Web (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> The creature is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect also ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Ettin
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Two Heads.</Bold></Italic> The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Wakeful.</Bold></Italic> When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Battleaxe.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Morningstar.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Fire Elemental
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Fire Form.</Bold></Italic> The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Illumination.</Bold></Italic> The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Water Susceptibility.</Bold></Italic> For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The elemental makes two touch attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Touch.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Flameskull
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Illumination.</Bold></Italic> The flameskull sheds either dim light in a 15-foot radius, or bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. It can switch between the options as an action.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The flameskull has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Rejuvenation.</Bold></Italic> If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its hit points in 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a <Italic>dispel magic</Italic> or <Italic>remove curse</Italic> spell is cast on them.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The flameskull is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no somatic or material components to cast its spells. The flameskull has the following wizard spells prepared:</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"> </Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The flameskull uses Fire Ray twice.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Fire Ray.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Spell Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (3d6) fire damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Flesh Golem
Monsters.Damage Immunities: Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Adamantine
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Monsters.Languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Berserk.</Bold></Italic> Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Aversion of Fire.</Bold></Italic> If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Immutable Form.</Bold></Italic> The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.</Paragraph><Paragraph> <Italic><Bold>Lightning Absorption.</Bold></Italic> Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"> <Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The golem's weapon attacks are magical.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The golem makes two slam attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Flyby.</Bold></Italic> The snake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 1 piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

If targeted by dispel magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>False Appearance.</Bold></Italic> While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Longsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Ooze Cube.</Bold></Italic> The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw. </Paragraph><Paragraph>Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover.</Paragraph><Paragraph>A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The cube can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Transparent.</Bold></Italic> Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the cube's space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Pseudopod.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (3d6) acid damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Engulf.</Bold></Italic> The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.</Paragraph><Paragraph>On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.</Paragraph><Paragraph>On a failed save, the cube enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.</Paragraph><Paragraph>An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the cube.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Ghast
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Necrotic
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Stench.</Bold></Italic> Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Turning Defiance.</Bold></Italic> The ghast and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Ghost
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Acid, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
Monsters.Languages: Any languages it knew in life
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Ethereal Sight.</Bold></Italic> The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Incorporeal Movement.</Bold></Italic> The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Withering Touch.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Etherealness.</Bold></Italic> The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Horrifying Visage.</Bold></Italic> Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Possession (Recharge 6).</Bold></Italic> One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.</Paragraph><Paragraph>The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Gibbering Mouther

Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Gibbering.</Bold></Italic> The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther and can hear the gibbering must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
