Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hooves.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Roc
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Keen Sight.</Bold></Italic> The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Beak.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Talons.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the roc can't use its talons on another target.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Roper
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>False Appearance.</Bold></Italic> While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Grasping Tendrils.</Bold></Italic> The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Spider Climb.</Bold></Italic> The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The roper makes four attacks with its tendrils, uses Reel, and makes one attack with its bite. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Tendril.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the roper can't use the same tendril on another target. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Reel.</Bold></Italic> The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Rug of Smothering
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Antimagic Susceptibility.</Bold></Italic> The rug is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rug must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Damage Transfer.</Bold></Italic> While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>False Appearance.</Bold></Italic> While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Smother.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> The creature is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating, and the rug can't smother another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Rust Monster
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Iron Scent.</Bold></Italic> The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Rust Metal.</Bold></Italic> Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Antennae.</Bold></Italic> The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.</Paragraph><Paragraph>If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Keen Smell.</Bold></Italic> The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Pounce.</Bold></Italic> If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Claw.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Sahuagin
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Blood Frenzy.</Bold></Italic> The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Limited Amphibiousness.</Bold></Italic> The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shark Telepathy.</Bold></Italic> The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The sahuagin makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Spear.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee or <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic></Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Salamander
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Heated Body.</Bold></Italic> A creature that touches the salamander or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Heated Weapons.</Bold></Italic> Any metal melee weapon the salamander wields deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit (included in the attack).</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The salamander makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its tail. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spear.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee or <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic></Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft./60 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Tail.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Satyr
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Ram.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shortsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shortbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Scorpion
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sting.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Scout
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Keen Hearing and Sight.</Bold></Italic> The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shortsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Longbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Sea Hag
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Amphibious.</Bold></Italic> The hag can breathe air and water. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Horrific Appearance.</Bold></Italic> Any humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the hag is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the hag's Horrific Appearance for the next 24 hours.</Paragraph><Paragraph>Unless the target is surprised or the revelation of the hag's true form is sudden, the target can avert its eyes and avoid making the initial saving throw. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that averts its eyes has disadvantage on attack rolls against the hag.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Death Glare.</Bold></Italic> The hag targets one frightened creature she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see the hag, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or drop to 0 hit points. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Illusory Appearance.</Bold></Italic> The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like an ugly creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The effect ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.</Paragraph><Paragraph>The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have no claws, but someone touching her hand might feel the claws. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Sea Horse
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Water Breathing.</Bold></Italic> The sea horse can breathe only underwater.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />

Monsters.name: Shadow
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Amorphous.</Bold></Italic> The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shadow Stealth.</Bold></Italic> While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sunlight Weakness.</Bold></Italic> While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Strength Drain.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.</Paragraph><Paragraph>If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Shambling Mound
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Cold, Fire
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Lightning Absorption.</Bold></Italic> Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Engulf.</Bold></Italic> The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Shield Guardian
Monsters.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.,  Passive Perception 10
Monsters.Languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bound.</Bold></Italic> The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Regeneration.</Bold></Italic> The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Spell Storing.</Bold></Italic> A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The guardian makes two fist attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Fist.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Shrieker
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>False Appearance.</Bold></Italic> While the shrieker remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />

Monsters.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
Monsters.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.,  Passive Perception 14
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Cold Breath.</Bold></Italic> The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Paralyzing Breath.</Bold></Italic> The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Skeleton
Monsters.Languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shortsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shortbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Solar
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Angelic Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The solar's weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack). </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Divine Awareness.</Bold></Italic> The solar knows if it hears a lie. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The solar's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only) </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">1/day each: commune, control weather </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The solar makes two greatsword attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Greatsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Slaying Longbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Flying Sword.</Bold></Italic> The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If the solar can see the sword, the solar can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to the solar's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the solar dies. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Healing Touch (4/Day).</Bold></Italic> The solar touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Legendary Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The solar can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The solar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Teleport.</Bold></Italic> The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions).</Bold></Italic> The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions).</Bold></Italic> The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Spectator
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 2 (1d6 − 1) piercing damage.</Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Eye Rays.</Bold></Italic> The spectator shoots up to two of the following magical eye rays at one or two creatures it can see within 90 feet of it. It can use each ray only once on a turn.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"> </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Create Food and Water.</Bold></Italic> The spectator magically creates enough food and water to sustain itself for 24 hours.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Specter
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
Monsters.Languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Incorporeal Movement.</Bold></Italic> The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sunlight Sensitivity.</Bold></Italic> While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Life Drain.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Spell Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Spider
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spider Climb.</Bold></Italic> The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Web Sense.</Bold></Italic> While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Web Walker.</Bold></Italic> The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Spirit Naga
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Rejuvenation.</Bold></Italic> If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The naga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following wizard spells prepared: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">Cantrips (at will): mage hand, minor illusion, ray of frost </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, sleep </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, hold person </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">3rd level (3 slots): lightning bolt, water breathing </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door </Paragraph><Paragraph>5th level (2 slots): dominate person</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Sprite
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Longsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 1 slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shortbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. If its saving throw result is 5 or lower, the poisoned target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it awake. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Heart Sight.</Bold></Italic> The sprite touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state. If the target fails a DC 10 Charisma saving throw, the sprite also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Invisibility.</Bold></Italic> The sprite magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the sprite wears or carries is invisible with it.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Spy
Monsters.Skills: Deception +5, Insight +4, Investigation +5, Perception +6, Persuasion +5, Sleight of Hand +4, Stealth +4
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Cunning Action.</Bold></Italic> On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sneak Attack (1/Turn).</Bold></Italic> The spy deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The spy makes two melee attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shortsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hand Crossbow.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Steam Mephit
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Death Burst.</Bold></Italic> When the mephit dies, it explodes in a cloud of steam. Each creature within 5 feet of the mephit must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) fire damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic>(1/Day). The mephit can innately cast blur, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claws.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 2 (1d4) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Steam Breath (Recharge 6).</Bold></Italic> The mephit exhales a 15- foot cone of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Stirge
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" />
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Blood Drain.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.</Paragraph><Paragraph>The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Stone Giant
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Stone Camouflage.</Bold></Italic> The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The giant makes two greatclub attacks. Greatclub. <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Rock.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Stone Golem

Monsters.Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Monsters.Languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Immutable Form.</Bold></Italic> The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Weapons.</Bold></Italic> The golem's weapon attacks are magical.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The golem makes two slam attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Slow (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Storm Giant
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Cold
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Amphibious.</Bold></Italic> The giant can breathe air and water. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Innate Spellcasting.</Bold></Italic> The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">At will: detect magic, feather fall, levitate, light </Paragraph><Paragraph>3/day each: control weather, water breathing</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The giant makes two greatsword attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Greatsword.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Rock.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Ranged Weapon Attack:</Italic> +14 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Lightning Strike (Recharge 5–6).</Bold></Italic> The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Succubus/Incubus
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Telepathic Bond.</Bold></Italic> The fiend ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shapechanger.</Bold></Italic> The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the fiend loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw (Fiend Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Charm.</Bold></Italic> One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The fiend can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Draining Kiss.</Bold></Italic> The fiend kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Etherealness.</Bold></Italic> The fiend magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Tarrasque

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Legendary Resistance (3/Day).</Bold></Italic> If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Reflective Carapace.</Bold></Italic> Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Siege Monster.</Bold></Italic> The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Shapechanger.</Bold></Italic> If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.</Paragraph><Paragraph>While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can’t pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Legendary Resistance (3/Day).</Bold></Italic> If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Misty Escape.</Bold></Italic> When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Regeneration.</Bold></Italic> The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spider Climb.</Bold></Italic> The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Vampire Weaknesses.</Bold></Italic> The vampire has the following flaws: </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic>Forbiddance.</Italic> The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic>Harmed by Running Water.</Italic> The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic>Stake to the Heart.</Italic> If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is incapacitated in its resting place, the vampire is paralyzed until the stake is removed. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic>Sunlight Hypersensitivity.</Italic> The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack. (Vampire Form Only).</Bold></Italic> The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18). </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite. (Bat or Vampire Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Charm.</Bold></Italic> The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Children of the Night (1/Day).</Bold></Italic> The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats (swarm of bats, swarm of rats), provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolves (wolf) instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Legendary Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">The vampire can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The vampire regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Move.</Bold></Italic> The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Unarmed Strike.</Bold></Italic> The vampire makes one unarmed strike. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Bite.</Bold></Italic>(Costs 2 Actions). The vampire makes one bite attack.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Magic Resistance.</Bold></Italic> The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The vrock makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Beak.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Talons.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Spores (Recharge 6).</Bold></Italic> A 15­-foot­-radius cloud of toxic spores extends out from the vrock. The spores spread around corners. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a target takes 5 (1d10) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Emptying a vial of holy water on the target also ends the effect on it. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Stunning Screech (1/Day).</Bold></Italic> The vrock emits a horrific screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a demon must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Vulture
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Keen Sight and Smell.</Bold></Italic> The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Pack Tactics.</Bold></Italic> The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Beak.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 2 (1d4) piercing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Warhorse
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Trampling Charge.</Bold></Italic> If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Hooves.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Water Elemental
Monsters.Damage Resistances: Acid; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
Monsters.Condition Immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Water Form.</Bold></Italic> The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Freeze.</Bold></Italic> If the elemental takes cold damage, it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The elemental makes two slam attacks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Slam.</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Whelm (Recharge 4–6).</Bold></Italic> Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it is also grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the elemental's space.</Paragraph><Paragraph>The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the elemental's turns, each target grappled by it takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength and succeeding.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.name: Werebear
Monsters.Armor Class: 10 In Humanoid Form, 11 In Bear And Hybrid Form
Monsters.Speed: 30 ft., 40 ft., climb 30 ft. in bear or hybrid form
Monsters.Damage Immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shapechanger.</Bold></Italic> The werebear can use its action to polymorph into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid or into a Large bear, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Keen Smell.</Bold></Italic> The werebear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> In bear form, the werebear makes two claw attacks. In humanoid form, it makes two greataxe attacks. In hybrid form, it can attack like a bear or a humanoid. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Bite (Bear or Hybrid Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werebear lycanthropy. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Claw (Bear or Hybrid Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Greataxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>

Monsters.Damage Immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Shapechanger.</Bold></Italic> The wereboar can use its action to polymorph into a boar-humanoid hybrid or into a boar, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest).</Bold></Italic> If the wereboar takes 14 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only).</Bold></Italic> The wereboar makes two attacks, only one of which can be with its tusks. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Maul (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. </Paragraph><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Tusks (Boar or Hybrid Form Only).</Bold></Italic> <Italic>Melee Weapon Attack:</Italic> +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. <Italic>Hit:</Italic> 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. Monsters.name: Wight

Monsters.Languages: The languages it knew in life
Monsters.Traits: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph><Italic><Bold>Sunlight Sensitivity.</Bold></Italic> While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
Monsters.Actions: <FlowDocument xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Multiattack.</Bold></Italic> The wight makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.</Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve">A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the wight's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the will-o'-wisp regains 10 (3d6) hit points. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Ephemeral.</Bold></Italic> The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything. </Paragraph><Paragraph xml:space="preserve"><Italic><Bold>Incorporeal Movement.</Bold></Italic> The will-o'-wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a bonus action.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
